label: Real scan, names removed
what_this_is: A real Google Listing and Map Audit of one Houston-area dental practice, run on 12 October 2026 by the same code that builds every audit. The practice's name, address, phone, website, email and owner, and every other practice's name, are removed. Ratings, review counts (rounded to the nearest 10), search counts and check results are as measured.

scan.when: Mon 12 Oct, 10:31 am to 12:59 pm, Houston time
scan.demand_line: Google counts about 128,630 searches a month for a dentist in the Houston area.

headline.sentence: In the top three at 0 of 158 searches within 10 miles, and not in the first twenty at any of them.
headline.leader_sentence: Practice A was in the top three for 35 of the same 158.
headline.contrast: 5.0 stars on 90 reviews, higher than all three practices that came up instead.
headline.email_diagnosis: Here is the part that does not add up. You are rated 5.0 stars. That is higher than all three of the practices above you, and you still do not come up in the top three.

map.legend: Each pin is one real Google search on a phone, two miles apart, within 10 miles of the practice (purple). Green: in the top three. Yellow: fourth to twentieth. Grey: not in the first twenty.
map.basemap: none: the street map, scale bar and credit are removed so the pin pattern cannot place the practice

who_came_up.note: The three practices that held the top three most often near the sample practice, on the phrase the map draws.

who_came_up_both_phrases.note: The audit PDF's own table: top-three counts over both phrases.

recommended_fixes.fix: The leading practices near you have more reviews
recommended_fixes.how: Ask for a review after every visit, the same day.
Reply to every review within a week, in your own words. Never confirm they are a patient or mention their care.
One post a month, with what is new at the practice.
